findings.title: Missing Security Header: Content-Security-Policy on /api/vulnerable/profile
findings.evidence: Header "Content-Security-Policy" was not returned by server in response to GET /api/vulnerable/profile
reproduction_steps: Inspect response headers for presence of "Content-Security-Policy"
findings.impact: Missing Content-Security-Policy degrades browser-side defense-in-depth protections.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Frame-Options on /api/vulnerable/profile
findings.evidence: Header "X-Frame-Options" was not returned by server in response to GET /api/vulnerable/profile
reproduction_steps: Inspect response headers for presence of "X-Frame-Options"
findings.impact: Missing X-Frame-Options degrades browser-side defense-in-depth protections.
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN to prevent Clickjacking.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Content-Type-Options on /api/vulnerable/profile
findings.evidence: Header "X-Content-Type-Options" was not returned by server in response to GET /api/vulnerable/profile

findings.impact: Missing X-Content-Type-Options degrades browser-side defense-in-depth protections.
findings.remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to prevent MIME-sniffing.

findings.title: Technology Fingerprint Disclosed via X-Powered-By on /api/vulnerable/profile
findings.impact: Exposes underlying framework and potential version details to reconnaissance.
findings.remediation: Disable fingerprinting in Express via app.disable("x-powered-by") or helmet.hidePoweredBy().
